simple.meaning: חָשַׁק (châshaq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to cling , i.e. join , (figuratively) to love , delight in ; elliptically; to deliver.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across Genesis, Exodus, Deuteronomy, 1 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 34:8. Its contexts include family, family line.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָשַׁק (H2836).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: חָשַׁק (châshaq) / H2836 is traced through Genesis 34:8, Exodus 27:17, Exodus 38:17, Exodus 38:28 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to cling , i.e. join , (figuratively) to love , delight in ; elliptically; to deliver
definitions.usage: have a delight, (have a) desire, fillet, long, set (in) love.
definitions.full: H2836. chashaq I. חָשַׁק verb be attached to, love (Late Hebrew press together, desire (rare); Aramaic חֲשַׁק bind , saddle (an ass)) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Deut 7:7 4 t.; חָֽשְׁקָה Gen 34:8 ; חָשַׁקְתָּ Isa 38:17 (but see below); וְחָֽשַׁקְתָּ֫ Deut 21:11 ; — be attached to , only figurative = love , a woman followed by בְּ Gen 34:8 (P) Deut 21:11 ; elsewhere of ׳י s; love for Israel 7:7 ; 10:15 , and of love to ׳י Psa 91:14 ; followed by accusative of congnate meaning with verb+ לְ and infinitive לִבְנוֺת ח אשׁר שְׁלֹמה ׳כלחֵֿשֶׁק 1Kin 9:19 2Chr 8:6 ; מִשַּׁחַת נַפְשִׁי חָשַׁקְתָּ Isa 38:17 literally thou hast loved my soul out of the pit , i.e. lovingly delivered it; but read חָשַׂכְתָּ thou hast held back, kept , from ᵑ9 ᵐ5 Lo Ew Che Di, or חֲשׂךְ hold back (Imperative), so Du. II. [ חשׁק ] verb denominative only Pi`el furnish with fillets or rings , and Pu`al passive; Pi`el Perfect 3masculine singular חִשַּׁק Exod 38:28 (P), subject Bezaleel. Pu`al Participle כֶּסֶף מְחֻשָּׁקִים Exod 27:17 ; 38:17 finished with silver fillets , in agreement with הָעַמּוּדִים (both P).

occurrences.englishText: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.
All the pillars of the court around shall be filleted with silver; their hooks of silver, and their sockets of bronze.
The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels* A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1775 shekels is about 17.75 kilograms or about 39 pounds. he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

Only Yahweh had a delight in your fathers to love them, and he chose their offspring after them, even you above all peoples, as it is today.
